Future<void> run(items) async {
 for (final item in items) {
  switch (item.kind) { case 'a':
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
   await save(item); break;
  }
 }
 for (final item in items) {
  for (final child in item.children) { if (child.done) break; }
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await save(item);
 }
 for (final item in items) { await save(item); if (item.done) break; }
 for (final item in items) {
  switch (item.kind) { default: break; }
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await save(item);
 }
}
